messages:
diego-sales: AetherLane POC kickoff note: they hit high 429/503 during scripted warmups and the security team requested SSQ answers. Need triage + short reserve pricing + a handoff doc by EOD.

lena-se: Share a sample request/response and approximate ramp profile. 429 vs quota or proxy throttles?

diego-sales: Devs provided this curl and response:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_test_xyz' -d '{"model":"redwood-gen","input":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 1
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Req-ID: rwd-324f
```
They ramp 0->180 RPS in ~90s with many parallel connections.

priya-eng: Sounds like quota exhaustion + occasional routing thrash causing 503s when fallback spins. Immediate ask: add exponential backoff + cap concurrency on client side.

zack-ml: For quick mitigation: 1) route warmup traffic to a verified smaller/cheaper variant to avoid cold model instantiation 2) enable KV prefix caching for repeated prompts 3) we can open a temporary dedicated burst if infra approves.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-10111 created for aetherlane-poc routing pressure. Assigned to infra-sre.

infra-sre: We have spare capacity in us-west-2 but cross-tenant burst requires manual approval. Will escalate.

lena-se: I'll take the SSQ KMS/encryption questions. Diego, send me the specific fields flagged by their security team.

diego-sales: Sent the SSQ fields. Also they asked for a short written SLA during the demo window.

priya-eng: Timeline options: if infra approves burst routing, we can flip in ~25-30 mins. Backoff + client cap is immediate. Caching/config change ~2-3 hours.

zack-ml: Pricing ballpark: 2-week dedicated reserve for their described load ~ $2.6k (small GPU profile). On-demand bursts ~ $3k. I'll prepare a short calc and send.

infra-sre: Approved temporary burst. Routing rule staged; will activate at 2100000300.

diego-sales: I'll tell their SRE to pause manual warmups until we flip routing. Also asking for average and peak token lengths for final pricing.

zack-ml: They provided avg ~450 tokens, peaks ~1200. With that, estimate stays ~ $2.6k for 2 weeks. Sending spreadsheet to Diego + Lena.

lena-se: Uploaded preliminary SSQ answers and KMS screenshots to the internal share. Legal will follow on DPA.

oncall-bot: Routing flip executed at 2100000300. Monitoring metrics now.

infra-sre: Early telemetry: 429s down ~80%, 5xx reduced significantly. Keeping extra workers for 90 minutes.

diego-sales: Customer confirmed demo proceeded and reported fewer errors. They want the pricing email + SSQ summary. I'll draft and send. Thanks team.

priya-eng: Follow-ups: 1) schedule KV-cache rollout (June) 2) recommend client-side backoff + concurrency caps in integration guide 3) keep temporary burst until warmup window ends.

diego-sales: Noted. Closing this thread; will re-open if SSQ/legal needs more info. :white_check_mark:
